$comment: Properties every :catalog render must hold, checked by the design-artifacts workflow against the data products the render already wrote, before anything publishes. Format and failure semantics: https://github.com/yschimke/compose-ai-tools/blob/main/docs/RENDER_ASSERTIONS.md. The visual diff answers 'did this change?'; these answer 'is it still true?'. Previews that lay out no text write an empty fonts-used and are skipped by the checker itself, judged from their semantics.

assertions.because: Wear M3 typography carries its weights on Roboto Flex's variation axes (wght 450-580), not on named faces; a static font instance drops every axis without an error and the whole sheet renders at one weight — the failure glimmer-catalog shipped for its entire life before this check existed
